name: Minimal
_about: Minimal HUD, generated by design/gen_hud.py: built round BMW's own speed and speed-limit sign (bottom left), which it never covers: a thin shift bar beside them, the gear right of BMW's speed, one readout slot at the right. Fitted (Nov 9 2026) to the HUD as BMW's own height-adjust frame shows it, x 120..680, y 100..380, and kept clear of the bottom-left x 120..350, y 235..380, where BMW draws its speed and speed-limit sign (and in Sport its rev band) over ours. To change it, copy this file into the app data folder layouts/ (scripts/deploy.sh); the app reloads it by itself. Widget types and tokens: see the header of hud.js.
